class.name: TurboData
class.brief_description: A resource that defines turbocharger characteristics: spool rates, max boost, and RPM ranges.
class.description:
TurboData is a [Resource] that configures a turbocharger simulation for the vehicle's engine. The turbo builds boost progressively based on engine RPM and exhaust flow, adding extra torque above atmospheric pressure.
Boost pressure follows a curve: it starts building at [member start_rpm], reaches maximum at [member max_boost_rpm], and optionally falls off after [member fall_rpm]. The [member spool_up] and [member spool_down] rates control how quickly boost responds to throttle changes.

members.member: Turbo spool-up rate. Higher values make the turbo reach target boost faster under acceleration.
Turbo spool-down rate. Higher values make boost drop faster when lifting off the throttle.
Maximum boost pressure in psi above atmospheric.
Engine RPM at which the turbo starts building boost.
Engine RPM at which maximum boost is reached.
Engine RPM after which boost begins to taper off (if above max_boost_rpm).
